question_text: Explain the importance of Database Management Systems.
model_answer: A Database Management System (DBMS) is software used to store, organize, manage, and retrieve data efficiently. It helps maintain data accuracy, security, and consistency. Reference: A Database Management System (DBMS) is software used to store, organize, manage, and retrieve data efficiently. It helps maintain data accuracy, security, and consistency. DBMS is useful in applications such as banking systems, education platforms, hospitals, and online shopping websites.
Rubric: C1: A Database Management System is software for storing, organizing, managing, and retrieving data. | C2: A DBMS supports efficient storage, organization, querying, or retrieval of records. | C3: A DBMS helps maintain data accuracy, integrity, or consistency. | C4: A DBMS provides security or controlled access to information. | C5: A DBMS can support multiple users or applications while reducing unnecessary duplication of data. | C6: DBMSs are used in applications such as banking, hospitals, education systems, or e-commerce.
Difference: [DIFF3]
Student: A DBMS provides a structured way to manage and access large collections of data. It supports efficient storage, organization, querying, and retrieval of records. A DBMS helps maintain data accuracy, integrity, and consistency. It can support many users and applications while reducing unnecessary duplication of data. DBMSs are important in banking, hospitals, education systems, and e-commerce applications.
